ablage.einleitung: The versions on the left, the selected one on the right. Without a choice the latest.
ablagen.einleitung: Texts your flows have written — with a history, like the metric series. A review, a report, a log: what a flow produced stays here.
ablagen.keine: No storage yet. It comes into being the first time a flow puts something in.
abschalter.hinweis_abbrechen: Runs end here as cancelled, visible in the operations view with the name of the step.
abschalter.hinweis_ueberspringen: The step does nothing, the flow continues through the normal outlet.
accept_invite.kein_token: No invitation token in the address.
action_fields.0_aus_der_ablauf_laeuft_we: 0 = off. The flow still runs on every call, only the message stays away. Needed where the far side does not summarize by itself: a tracker repeats its alarm every few seconds while it is on.
action_fields.0_nicht_pruefen_gemeldet_w: 0 = do not check. Reported once per phase of silence; as soon as a value arrives again it starts over.
action_fields.aus_der_ablauf_entscheidet: Off: the flow decides for itself using tool.ok at a decision.
action_fields.die_liste_kommt_aus_deinen: The list comes from your MCP servers (Settings, MCP servers).
action_fields.ergaenzen_entfernen_lohnt_: Adding and removing only pays off on multi select fields.
action_fields.geraete_melden_unsinn_wenn: Devices report nonsense when they do not know something, and such values do not belong in the series (the tracker sends 127 % for unknown, for example).
action_fields.greift_wenn_keine_spalte_m: Applies when no column with a matching name exists.
action_fields.haengt_eine_zeile_an_eine_: Appends a line to a note in the vault, creating it when it does not exist yet.
action_fields.laeuft_asynchron_der_ausga: Runs asynchronously; the outlet is named after the result: merged, conflict, pr_open, no_git.
action_fields.leer_der_agent_aus_dem_aus: Empty = the agent from the trigger. Without an agent it is simply passed through.
action_fields.leer_die_antwort_des_mensc: Empty = the person's answer from the context (spam.entschieden).
action_fields.leer_lassen_ist_der_normal: Leaving it empty is the normal case: everyone manages in their profile how they are reached. When the chosen channel is not on file there, the other one is used.
action_fields.leer_niemand_zuweisung_sta: Empty = nobody. Assigning starts the lifecycle.
action_fields.legt_die_im_plan_vorgeschl: Creates the subtasks proposed in the plan as child tickets (part 1 starts, the rest waits for its predecessor).
action_fields.legt_die_urteils_zeile_an_: Creates the verdict row and asks the question in the messenger. Below the immediate threshold the case waits for the digest card.
action_fields.legt_ein_neues_ticket_an_i: Creates a new ticket (in the project of the flow unless stated otherwise).
action_fields.liest_projekt_und_ticket_e: Reads project and ticket settings into the context (project.*, issue.*) so decisions can test them.
action_fields.macht_aus_der_mail_ein_ass: Turns the mail into an assistant item, the thing a person approves.
action_fields.mehrere_durch_komma_trenne: Separate several by comma. {{templates}} from the context are allowed.
action_fields.meldet_einen_vom_gedaechtn: Reports a case the memory already settled, as a note rather than a question.
action_fields.meldet_plan_freigabe_abnah: Reports plan approval, review, errors and blocks (default: on).
action_fields.mergt_den_ticket_branch_bz: Merges the ticket branch or opens a pull request.
action_fields.name_im_secret_tresor_im_a: Name in the secret vault, available in the call as {{secret}}.
action_fields.nur_bei_tickets_unterschei: Tickets only, it separates plan approval from split approval among others.
action_fields.ohne_haken_passiert_nichts: Without the checkbox nothing happens when auto deploy is off for the project.
action_fields.ordnet_die_eingegangene_ma: Classifies the incoming mail in house (category, urgency, redacted summary) and looks up the learned rule for the sender. Writes klasse.* into the context.
action_fields.pfad_darf_aus_dem_kontext_: The path may come from the context: that way each kind grows its own note without changing the flow.
action_fields.pfad_erlaubt_so_prueft_der: {{path}} allowed, so the same flow checks several series depending on the start context.
action_fields.raeumt_die_testumgebung_ab: Tears the test environment down (container, volumes, worktree, port).
action_fields.reiht_den_assistenten_lauf: Queues the assistant run (for items a learned rule already approved).
action_fields.ruft_ein_mcp_werkzeug_auf_: Calls an MCP tool: mail, vault, documents, cloud storage, home automation.
action_fields.ruft_eine_freie_url_auf_fu: Calls a free URL. For a far side you use again and again, create a destination instead.
action_fields.schickt_die_freigabekarte_: Sends the approval card for the assistant item.
action_fields.schickt_eine_benachrichtig: Sends a notification: the bell always, outside on the channel of the person.
action_fields.schluessel_der_reihe_gleic: Key of the series. Same key means same series.
action_fields.schreibt_das_urteil_fest_l: Commits the verdict, learns from it and moves the mail (spam folder or back into the inbox).
action_fields.schreibt_eine_zahl_in_eine: Writes a number into a series and reads off where it is heading.
action_fields.schreibt_einen_kommentar_a: Writes a comment on the bound ticket.
action_fields.schreibt_werte_in_den_proz: Writes values into the flow context (usable later as {{key}}).
action_fields.setzt_das_kostenfenster_ne: Resets the cost window: from here the runaway brake only counts fresh runs. Belongs at every human approval.
action_fields.setzt_den_zustand_des_arte: Sets the state of the artifact the flow hangs off, a ticket or hardware. The possible values come from the artifact registry.
action_fields.setzt_ein_freies_feld_des_: Sets a custom field of the artifact the flow hangs off. Which fields exist comes from the artifact registry (Administration, artifacts).
action_fields.sieht_eine_messreihe_an_oh: Looks at a series without feeding it, and notices when it goes quiet.
action_fields.startet_die_testumgebung_d: Starts the test environment of the ticket.
action_fields.verschiebt_das_ticket_in_e: Moves the ticket into a board column.
action_fields.was_als_dieselbe_nachricht: What counts as the same message. Empty = this node on its own; with {{path}} you separate by device or kind.
action_fields.weist_dem_ticket_einen_age: Assigns an agent to the ticket.
action_fields.wert_auf_den_die_reihe_zul: Value the series runs towards, 0 means empty.
action_fields.werte_duerfen_pfad_aus_dem: Values may contain {{path}} from the context.
action_fields.wie_frueh_gewarnt_werden_s: How early to warn. 0 turns the warning off; it warns once per refill, not on every value.
action_fields.wie_weit_zurueck_fuer_die_: How far back the line reads (default 30).
action_fields.wird_angelegt_wenn_es_ihn_: Created when it does not exist yet.
action_fields.zieht_regeln_lokales_model: Pulls rules, the local model and the memory together into one verdict.
action_params.wert_aus_kontext: The value comes from the context. Clear it to pick one.
admin.aktive_nutzer_koennen_sich_sofort_: Active users can log in right away, pending ones still need approval. Without a password the user cannot log in, without an email address there is no email login.
admin.mcp_provisionieren_hinweis: Then run python3 scripts/provision_mcp.py on the host, which creates the group and the token and assigns them to the user.
admin.passwort_zu_kurz: The password needs at least 8 characters (or leave it empty).
admin.projekt_das_den_laufenden_traccoon: Project that updates the running Traccoon stack
admin.sperren_hinweis: Logging in is blocked afterwards; running sessions end with their token. Unlocking is possible at any time.
admin.testumgebungen_hinweis: Applies to all projects. Changes take effect at once, no restart needed.
agent_monitor.aeltere_laeufe_sind_ausgeb: Older runs are hidden (display limit reached).
agent_monitor.kein_agent_arbeitet_gerade: No agent is working right now.
agent_task_config.der_am_ticket_zugewies: The agent assigned to the ticket
agents_badge.kein_wartungsprojekt: No maintenance project set. Choose under Administration, Maintenance which project deploys itself on an update.
agents_badge.update_eingereiht: Update queued. It starts once every agent has finished
agents_badge.update_laeuft_stack_wird_ne: 🔄 Update running, the stack is being redeployed…
agents_badge.updates_loest_ein_admin_aus: Updates are triggered by an admin.
agents_panel.denk_tiefe_leer_standard_lo: Reasoning effort (empty = default, low/medium/high/xhigh/max), shares max_tokens with the answer
agents_panel.einleitung_eigene: Agent roles (prompt, model, abilities). Without a definition of your own the worker uses sensible defaults.
agents_panel.einleitung_projekt: Agents for this project (provider, model and token per role). Roles that are not configured here fall back to your personal agents.
agents_panel.erst_speichern_dann_mcp_ser: Save first, then grant MCP servers.
agents_panel.liest_das_gedaechtnis_und_l: Reads the memory and learns from every run
agents_panel.skills_der_agent_bekommt_si: Skills (the agent receives them; auto = always in the prompt, otherwise on demand)
agents_panel.verfuegbare_modelle_live_be: Fetch available models live from the providers (uses your tokens)
akte.aufbewahrung_hinweis: Older runs are removed by the retention (run_retention_days), so this never says "ever", always a window.
akte.balken_abgebrochen_titel: Failed or stuck in the loop (failed + loop_exhausted), the cases where the role really did not deliver.
akte.balken_abgeliefert_titel: Finished successfully or a finished plan (success + planned). A plan waiting for approval is delivered work, not a failure.
akte.balken_wartet_titel: The run hangs on a question, a permission or an approval (blocked). That is not the agent's failure but a promise of ours that is still open.
akte.kein_fehlschlag: No reported failure. Old data without a measured result counts neither as success nor as failure.
akte.kein_mittelwert: No average: a single 36 hour run would shift it so far that it says nothing about any real run.
akte.kein_werkzeugaufruf: No tool call in the window.
akte.kosten_teilweise: At least one item has no price in the catalog (or predates it). The amount is a lower bound, the real one is higher.
akte.laeufe_titel: The population behind the three bars.
akte.letzter_lauf: Last run of this role in the chosen window.
akte.max_titel: The longest run in the window.
akte.median_titel: Half of all runs were faster than this.
akte.ohne_urteil: still running or without a verdict
akte.ohne_urteil_titel: Runs without a final verdict, usually still running.
akte.p90_titel: Nine out of ten runs were faster than this.
akte.rohe_status: The raw run states. The server builds the three bars above from them, this is what it counted.
akte.runden_titel: Passes through the agent loop (runs.iterations), how often the model was asked again. On average 6.9 here.
akte.schritte_titel: Lines in the event stream (run_steps): tool calls, messages, edits. On average 21.5 here, so quite a different thing from a round.
artifact_types_panel.abgeschaltete_felde: Disabled fields are no longer offered
artifact_types_panel.darf_ein_exemplar_m: May one item carry several values at once?
artifact_types_panel.eigenes_artefakt_hi: Gets a store of its own and any states you like. Board, sprints and the AI lifecycle stay with the tickets.
artifact_types_panel.eingebaut_hinweis: Built in — writes into the column {spalte}. Key and type are locked.
artifact_types_panel.einleitung: An artifact starts out undefined, its meaning comes from its fields. Tickets and hardware are nothing special then, just artifacts with a shipped set of fixed fields, and the state is one of those fields (status). The fields here apply everywhere, additions of a project are kept in that project's settings.
artifact_types_panel.loeschen_hinweis: The units of this artifact disappear with it.
artifact_types_panel.nicht_mehr_anbieten: Stop offering it (stays on existing artifacts)
asset_workflow.aktuell_kein_schritt_der_: No step is waiting for you right now.
asset_workflow.nicht_ladbar: The process could not be loaded.
asset_workflow.ohne_projekt: Stock or storage without a project, so no process.
asset_workflow.startet_prozess: Starts the project wide procurement process for this item
assistant_chat.einleitung: Tell the assistant what to do. It operates the system (with your rights) and your services, and asks before anything delicate, here or in the messenger.
assistant_chat.leer: Nothing yet. Try: "which projects do I have?" or "cost of ABC-23?"
assistant_policies.einleitung: Rules the assistant has learned. When a rule matches an incoming mail it may run automatically (redacted or not) and carries the learned action. Order: sender before domain before category.
assistant_policies.keine_der_assistent_f: None, the assistant asks before every sensitive action.
assistant_policies.keine_regeln: No rules yet. Choose "always …" when approving an incoming mail and a rule appears here.
assistant_policies.rechte_hinweis: What the assistant may do without asking. allow = always, deny = never, otherwise it asks (once, always, never). Patterns like obsidian__* are allowed.
auto_action_config.wiederholung_hinweis: A call to the outside usually fails for a moment only. Once the attempts are used up the run continues through the red error outlet, and ends if that one is not wired.
baumeister.auf_bestand_bauen: Build on what is on the canvas
baumeister.auf_der_flaeche: On the canvas, not saved yet. Look at it before you save.
baumeister.fehlende_stellen: {anzahl} spots are still missing, they are listed below with the checks.
baumeister.kein_ablauf: No flow came back. Describe it a bit more precisely.
baumeister.platzhalter: What should the flow do? For instance "fetch the open orders every night and send me a summary"
baumeister.platzhalter_umbau: What should change? For example: put an approval in front of the deployment
board.fertig_nur_ueber_knopf: To "done" only through "set to done" on the ticket, which stops the test environment and merges the branch.
buero.andere_gedimmt: other characters are dimmed, not removed
buero.ganze_seite: Open the office on the whole page
buero.kein_strom: No live stream. The history so far is shown, new events are missing.
buero.kosten_geschaetzt: Estimated against the current price catalog. Billed: {abgerechnet}
buero.kosten_teilweise: At least one model has no price in the catalog, so the total is a lower bound and the real amount is higher. (An entry of 0.00 would be priced and free; this one is unknown.) Billed: {abgerechnet}
buero.strom_haengt: The live stream stalled and the history was fetched instead.
dashboard.keine_laeufe: No runs in this period yet.
deploy.baut_neu: Rebuilds and restarts the stack in {ordner}.
deploy.einreihen_fehlgeschlagen: The deployment could not be queued.
deploy.kein_arbeitsverzeichnis: No working directory is configured for this project (Settings, Git). Without a stack directory there is nothing to build.
deploy.kein_treffer_filter: No row matches the chosen filter.
deploy.laeuft_bereits: A deployment for this project is already running: two builds in the same directory get in each other's way.
deploy.liste_nicht_verfuegbar: The deployment list is not available here yet.
deploy.rolle_fehlt: Deploying needs at least the maintainer role.
deployments_panel.abgebrochen_erklaerung: No code path writes "cancelled": these {anzahl} entries come from a one off cleanup of a stuck queue, done by hand. They are here so the total adds up, they are not failures.
deployments_panel.abgebrochen_kurz: The cancelled ones come from a one off cleanup, not from a failure.
deployments_panel.eingereiht_als: Queued as #{nummer}. The deployer picks the entry up within seconds, the progress shows in the list below.
deployments_panel.warnung_ausfall: The service is briefly unreachable while it restarts.
deployments_panel.warnung_kein_rollback: There is no automatic rollback: if the build or the start fails, the new state stays and has to be taken back by hand.
deployments_panel.warnung_welcher_stand: What gets deployed is the state of the checked out branch there, not your local work and not the worktree of a ticket.
deployments_panel.was_passiert: In {ordner} the deployer fetches the current state of the branch (git pull --ff-only), rebuilds the images and restarts the containers.
destinations_panel.einleitung: A destination holds the base URL and the credentials of an external system. Processes, jobs and (where granted) AI agents later call it by name and add method, path, query, headers and body. Credentials are stored encrypted and never shown again.
destinations_panel.einleitung_projekt: A project destination overrides a personal or system wide one of the same name.
destinations_panel.einleitung_user: Personal destinations apply in all of your projects.
destinations_panel.loeschen_hinweis: Flows and jobs addressing it will run into nothing afterwards.
destinations_panel.name_fest: The name stays: flows and jobs address the destination by it.
destinations_panel.probeaufruf_get_auf_d: Test call (GET on the base URL)
destinations_panel.wie_viel_der_antwort_: How much of the response the caller sees at most. Raise it only when the far side deliberately delivers its state in one call.
diff.gleich: Both versions do the same; the difference is only in the arrangement.
dock.selber_moment: The dock shows the same moment as the room.
dock.unbekannt_altdaten: unknown, old data without a measured result
editor.abweichung_titel: Outside the published version runs. Publishing takes this one over.
editor.anordnen_titel: Arrange the blocks top to bottom (gap {abstand} px)
editor.entwurf_uebernommen: Draft taken over, not saved yet.
editor.entwurf_verwerfen_hinweis: The editor then shows the published version again. Whatever was in the draft is gone.
editor.entwurf_verwerfen_titel: Back to the version that is running
editor.hilfe_loeschen: Delete a connection: hover the line and click ✕, or select it and press delete.
editor.hilfe_verbinden: Draw a connection: from an outlet onto the inlet of the next node.
editor.live_titel: What is on the canvas here also applies outside.
editor.nichts_zu_veroeffentlichen: The published version is already this one.
editor.nie_veroeffentlicht_titel: This flow runs nowhere yet. Publishing makes it startable.
editor.noch_nicht_geprueft: This version has not been checked yet.
editor.ungespeichert_titel: The canvas differs from the saved version.
editor.unterschied_ansehen: Look at the difference from the running version
err.account_waiting_enabled: The account is waiting to be enabled
err.agent_working_right_now_stop_first: The agent is working right now, stop it first
err.ai_right_target_project_required: The AI right in the target project is required
err.builtin_field_cannot_be_deleted: A shipped field cannot be deleted, the board, the sprints and the AI lifecycle run on it. Disabling it works.
err.builtin_type_cannot_be_deleted: Built-in types cannot be deleted (only switched off)
err.deployment_already_running: A deployment is already running for this project (#{id}). Wait until it is through, two simultaneous builds in the same stack directory get in each other's way.
err.destination_already_exists_scope: The destination '{name}' already exists in this scope
err.direct_jump_to_done: On to "done" only over "set to done", which stops the test environment and merges the branch.
err.draft_is_current: This draft is the current version and cannot be discarded
err.e_mail_user_name_already_taken: E-mail or user name already taken
err.field_does_not_exist_artifact: The field '{name}' does not exist on this artifact
err.field_still_carries_values: The field carries values in {anzahl} place(s). To disable it set `enabled=false`, to delete it for good repeat with force=true.
err.file_too_large_editor: File too large for the editor
err.file_too_large_preview: File too large for the preview
err.finished_sprint_cannot_started: A finished sprint cannot be started
err.flow_belongs_somebody_else: This flow belongs to somebody else
err.flow_has_no_version_yet: The flow has no version yet
err.flow_not_coherent: The flow is not coherent yet: {fehler}
err.folder_has_role: '{folder}' is the {role} folder of this account. Change that first.
err.git_not_active_project: Git is not active for this project
err.identity_not_of_account: The identity does not belong to this account
err.invitation_other_address: This invitation is addressed to another e-mail address
err.key_already_taken_project: The key is already taken in the project
err.key_fixed: This flow belongs to a set or a fixed task — its key stays
err.key_invalid: The key needs letters or digits
err.last_status_cannot_deleted: The last status cannot be deleted
err.list_needs_all_statuses: The list has to contain exactly all statuses of the project
err.maintainer_rights_target_project: Maintainer rights in the target project are required
err.model_still_has_units: {anzahl} unit(s) use this model, remove them first
err.no_access_target_project: No access to the target project
err.no_approval_waiting_right_now: No approval is waiting right now
err.no_archive_folder: This account has no archive folder configured
err.no_junk_folder: This account has no junk folder configured
err.no_process_for_ticket: No process is running for this ticket, please assign an agent
err.no_published_lifecycle_process_proje: No published lifecycle process for this project

err.object_does_not_belong_project: The object does not belong to this project
err.only_admin_may_change_global_process: Only an admin may change global process sets
err.only_admin_may_create_system_wide: Only an admin may create system-wide destinations
err.only_admin_may_maintain_artifacts: Only an admin may maintain artifacts
err.only_choice_has_value_list: Only a field of type "choice" has a value list
err.only_uploader_maintainer_may_delete: Only the uploader or a maintainer may delete
err.owner_may_only_removed_owner: An owner may only be removed by an owner
err.parent_below_project: The parent project lies below this project (cycle)
err.parent_project_does_not_exist: The parent project does not exist
err.placeholder_account_could_not_create: The placeholder account could not be created
err.placeholder_account_has_no_login: A placeholder account has no login
err.right_not_requested: The plugin does not ask for the right '{recht}'
err.port_range_reversed: Port range: the lower bound is above the upper one
err.process_created_no_sub_tasks_check_p: The process created no sub-tasks, check the plan
err.project_cannot_own_parent: A project cannot be its own parent
err.project_has_no_issue_types: The project has no issue types
err.push_failed_auth_network_conflict: The push failed (auth, network or conflict)
err.repo_not_ready: The repository is not ready yet (no clone or run yet)
err.role_higher_than_own: Cannot hand out a role higher than one's own
err.role_or_ai_right_required: Role owner|maintainer or the AI right (ai_assign) is required
err.rolling_back_only_possible_onto: Rolling back is only possible onto a published version
err.several_values_before_single: {anzahl} artifact(s) carry several values here, clean that up first, otherwise values would quietly get lost
err.source_language_cannot_switched_off: The source language cannot be switched off
err.sprint_still_running_close_first: The sprint "{name}" is still running, close it first
err.status_does_not_belong_project: The status does not belong to the project
err.status_one_of: status has to be one of {erlaubt}
err.status_still_has_tickets: {anzahl} ticket(s) stand in this status, move them first
err.step_not_open_approval: The step is not an open approval
err.step_not_open_human_task: The step is not an open human_task

files_panel.datei_links_auswaehlen: Pick a file on the left.
hardware.diese_schrittliste_als_grafisch: Edit this step list as a graphical flow
hardware.prozess_hinweis: The steps every new item goes through. Each step can name who is responsible.
hardware.prozess_wirkung: Applies to future items, existing ones keep their steps. If a drawn process already exists, saving publishes a new version of it, and procurements under way stay on their old version.
http_request.body: Body (JSON or text, ignored for GET/HEAD/DELETE)
http_request.ziele_pflegen: Destinations are kept in the administration, the settings or the project settings.
inbox.einleitung: Incoming mail is classified and redacted locally. Only your approval lets the assistant act, and you can have it learn a rule while you are at it ("from now on always …").
inbox.statistik_hinweis: As what your mail was classified. Counted from the existing verdicts, not from a counter of its own.
inbox.statistik_leer: Nothing was classified in this period.
inbox.statistik_modell: Hit rate of the local model
inbox.statistik_modell_hinweis: How often the model judged the same as you did. Only decided cases count.
inbox.volltext_geht_ungeschwaerzt_an_den: ⚠ The full text goes to the assistant unredacted.
inbox.z_b_in_paperless_ablegen_und_im_va: e.g. file it in the archive and document it in the vault
inspector.alle_laeufe: All runs of role {rolle} in the dock, this run stays here.
inspector.keine_figur: No character selected. Click somebody in the room or in the dock.
inspector.kosten_teilweise: This model has no price in the catalog (or the row predates it). The amount is a lower bound.
jobs_panel.einleitung: Scheduled jobs: cron (e.g. 0 8 * * *), interval (seconds) or once (ISO time). prompt = agent run, script = program, workflow starts a process instance.
jobs_panel.meldung_im_ablauf: What gets reported stands in the flow: a notify node, with a branch in front of it when it should not happen every time.
jobs_panel.name: Name
jobs_panel.startkontext_hinweis: Available in the flow as context, usable in switches and as {{name}}.
konto.assistent_fragen_hinweis: Questions you ask in the chat are always answered.
konto.assistent_meldungen_hinweis: The personal assistant works through the inbox quietly. Whether it reports back it decides itself: only when you need or want to know something (a deadline, an amount, a decision, a mishap). The result of every run stands in the inbox anyway.
konto.gedaechtnis_erklaerung: Folder in your Obsidian vault where the agents keep what you teach them, so you do not have to repeat it. They write there:
login.registriert: Registered. An admin may still need to activate the account.
mail.anhang_keine_vorschau: No preview for {typ} here — save it and open it in the right program.
mail.kein_spam_titel: Back to the inbox, and the detection learns from it.
mcp_panel.als_echte_editierbare_server_e: Take them over as real, editable server entries (replaces the gateway group).
mcp_panel.einleitung: Your own tool servers for agents. Tools are then called <name>__<tool>. Define variables (the credentials, for instance), then create one instance per agent and fill it in.
mcp_panel.label: Label
mcp_panel.nur_http_sse: Only http and sse are served (no stdio).
mcp_panel.variablen_werden_pro_instanz_a: Variables (filled per instance, applied as headers)
members.bestehenden_hinzufuegen: Add an existing user (user name or display name)
members.darf_ki_nutzen_tickets_zuweisen: May use AI and assign tickets
members.direkt_zugeordnet: An already registered user was added directly.
members.entfernen_hinweis: The person loses access to this project.
members.hinweis: If the address is already registered the user is added directly, otherwise they get an invitation mail with a sign in link. The AI permission drives the PM chat and agent assignment; owners and maintainers get it by default, members and viewers do not.
messreihen.reihe_loeschen_frage: Delete series {key} with all its values?
messreihen.zu_wenige_werte: too few values for a forecast
messreihen_panel.diesen_wert_entfernen_z: Remove this value, an outlier that bends the line for example
messreihen_panel.einleitung: Measurement series: the numbers flows record (the "measurement" action). The history gives the forecast: how much changes per day, when the target is reached, and whether the warning came in time.
messreihen_panel.keine_reihe: No series yet. One appears with the first value, so add the "measurement" action to a flow.
messreihen_panel.noch_keine_linie_dafuer: No line yet, that needs two values.
my_set_panel.einleitung: My default processes: ticket lifecycle, review, procurement and ticket intake for every project I own. Without a set of my own the shipped default applies.
my_set_panel.satz_anlegen: Create my own set (a copy of the default)
my_set_panel.satz_aufgeben_frage: Give up your own set? Your projects then follow the default again.
my_work.braucht_dich_hinweis: An agent is waiting for your permission, review or answer.
my_work.meine_schritte_hinweis: Process steps waiting for you (tasks and approvals).
my_work.mir_zugewiesen_hinweis: Open tickets you are responsible for.
my_work.nichts_offen: Nothing is waiting for you, no open tickets are assigned to you.
new_ticket_modal.screenshot_einfuegen: or paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V
node_config_panel.knoten_anklicken_um_ih: Click a node to configure it.
node_palette.bausteine_in_die_flaeche_zi: Building blocks, drag onto the canvas
node_palette.tippen_haengt_an: Tap to attach the block behind the selected one
office.kein_projekt_mit_diesem_schluesse: No project with this key, so the view shows all projects.
office_view.dock_umschalten: Show or hide dock and inspector (B)
office_view.esc_voll: Help, dock, replay, selection, and finally leave the page
office_view.pfeile: One second back or forward (ten with shift)
office_view.schwenken: Pan the room (the stage needs focus)
office_view.textfelder: Inside text fields every shortcut is off, that is where you type.
office_view.vollbild: Turn full screen on or off
office_view.welcher_raum: Which room is shown. The tabs above filter inside that room.
office_view.zoomen: Zoom and reset (the stage needs focus)
onboarding.einrichtung: Setup, this is what agents need
onboarding.pflicht_offen: While the required steps are open, every assignment to an agent stays untouched.
onboarding.rest_optional: The essentials are in place. The rest is optional.
own_workflows_panel.einleitung: Your own flows: no project, no slot. You start them from a job (Settings, Jobs, kind workflow), a webhook (mode workflow) or an agent (traccoon_start_workflow, needs a one time grant). They can only start once a version is published.
own_workflows_panel.name: Name
own_workflows_panel.schluessel_hinweis: Lower case letters, digits and hyphens. It names the subject, not its trigger — and has to be unique here.
plugins.einleitung: Self-contained views installed as a zip. A plugin runs sandboxed in the browser and reaches Traccoon data only through the rights released here.
plugins.loeschen_hinweis: The plugin's files and its own storage are deleted with it.
plugins.nicht_gefunden: This plugin does not exist or is not released for you.
plugins.recht_series_location: Read location series and their points
plugins.recht_series_number: Read metric series and their values
pm_chat.sag_dem_pm_was_zu_tun_ist_er_leg: Tell the PM what to do, it creates tickets and delegates to agents.
pm_chat.sag_was_zu_tun_ist_er_legt_ticke: Say what to do, it creates tickets and delegates to agents.
preferences_panel.flag_global_pause_hinw: The dispatcher pauses completely, nothing starts any more.
preferences_panel.flag_shift_end_hinweis: Start no new agent runs (running ones finish).
preferences_panel.flag_show_token_prices: Show the cost of each run in the interface.
preferences_panel.flag_sonnet_max_hinwei: Use the cheaper model for routine work.
preferences_panel.flag_strict_success_hi: A run counts as successful only when the verify command is green.
preferences_panel.flag_ticket_notify_hin: Report ticket events by chat message.
preferences_panel.gedaechtnis_hinweis: Empty means no memory. Access goes through your own tool group, so what is learned stays personal.
preferences_panel.nacht_tickets_jederzei: Night tickets run at any time.
preferences_panel.nur_wenn_ich_etwas_wis: Only when I need to know (recommended)
preferences_panel.tickets_mit_der_markie: Tickets marked as night work only start inside this window.
probelauf.hinweis_mit_nutzlast: Plays the draft through with the sample payload. Actions only report what they would do.
probelauf.kein_schritt: No step ran, the flow went straight to the end.
probelauf.ohne_beispiel: Without a sample payload on the start node the dry run has an empty context, so decisions hardly take effect.
proc.ausloeser_hinweis: What sets a flow going. This is read from the graphs themselves and from the references in webhooks and schedules, so there is no second list that could drift apart.
proc.betrieb_hinweis: All open runs across the projects. Waiting is the normal case: a flow waiting for a person is not broken. It becomes notable when it sits on the same step for more than a day or has failed.
proc.kein_vorgang: No run is going on right now.
proc.nichts_auffaelliges: Nothing unusual, no run is stuck.
proc.standard_hinweis: The shipped default applies to every project without a copy of its own. A change here takes effect there right away.
proc.zurueckrollen_frage: Put version v{version} back in force?
proc.zurueckrollen_hinweis: It is published as a new version; the old one stays, and running instances finish on the version they started on.
processes.diese_fassung_wieder_in_kraft_: Put this version back in force (as a new version)
processes.diese_projekte_haben_eine_eige: These projects have a copy of their own and no longer follow the default
processes.ereignisse_hinweis: These events happen during operation. A flow can catch them at its start node instead of being wired in by hand.
processes.ereignisse_niemand_hoert: Right now no flow listens to any of them, every flow is started by the program or by hand.
processes.hinweis_admin: Running instances are untouched: they stay on the version they started with.
processes.hinweis_leser: Only an admin can change it, but it is worth reading, because it describes how the work runs.
profile.benachrichtigungen_hinweis: You see everything in the interface anyway. This is about what goes out on top of that, and where, when the sender names no channel (the normal case).
profile.email_hinweis: Your email address for logging in. Clearing it and saving removes it, and then there is no email login.
profile.kein_weg_hinterlegt: Nothing is on file for the chosen default channel. Messages then go out on the other one, otherwise only into the bell.
profile.leer_lassen_anmelde_adresse: Leave empty and your sign in address applies
profile.passwort_zu_kurz: The new password needs at least 8 characters.
profile.pm_chat_hinweis: How the project manager chat looks. Terminal draws the history like a command line (monospace, dark background, prompt line), independent of the theme.
profile.sprache_hinweis: German is the source. When a text is missing in the chosen language, the German one is shown.
profile.ticket_open_hinweis: What a left click on a ticket does. A middle click always opens the full page in a new tab.
project_fields.abgeschaltete_felder_werd: Disabled fields are no longer offered
project_fields.darf_ein_ticket_mehrere_w: May one ticket carry several values at once?
project_fields.einleitung: An artifact gets its meaning from its fields. Tickets and hardware come with fixed ones, here you add your own, valid only in this project. They show up in the ticket and hardware view at once.
project_fields.nicht_mehr_anbieten: Stop offering it (stays on existing tickets)
project_settings.agenten_arbeiten_im_rep: Agents work in the repository, not only in the ticket.
project_settings.agenten_duerfen_die_tes: Agents may look at the test environment.
project_settings.aus_mitglieder_des_elte: Off: members of the parent project do NOT see this subproject automatically, only members added directly. On: owner rights are limited to maintainer here.
project_settings.blendet_den_hardware_ta: Shows the hardware tab (catalog, items, procurement).
project_settings.chat_tab_zum_delegieren: Chat tab for delegating to the project manager.
project_settings.ein_pruef_agent_liest_d: A reviewing agent reads the diff before the work is accepted.
project_settings.einzelne_orte_exemplare: Grant single locations or items to somebody without adding them to the whole project.
project_settings.ergebnis_landet_direkt_: The result lands in the remote directly.
project_settings.ergebnisse_gehen_erst_z: Results go to review first instead of straight to done.
project_settings.erschoepfte_laeufe_lauf: Exhausted runs continue until the limit kicks in.
project_settings.hint_auto_deploy: After review and merge the deployer builds and starts it.
project_settings.hint_branch: Ticket branches start here and are merged back here. Usually main.
project_settings.hint_pr: On review the branch is pushed and a pull request is opened (GitHub only). No auto deploy.
project_settings.hint_system_prompt: Project rules put in front of every agent.
project_settings.hint_testschritt: On: finished work lands on "testing" instead of being merged right away, the merge happens when you set it to done. Off: the old behaviour, merge straight to done.
project_settings.hint_verify: Has to be green before a run finishes, for example npm run build.
project_settings.hinweis_pull_request: Note: with "pull request instead of merge" nothing is deployed automatically, only after the merge.
project_settings.jedes_ticket_bekommt_ei: Every ticket gets its own branch and worktree. Subtickets are based on their parent's branch and merge back into it.
project_settings.laufen_im_worktree_vor_: Run inside the worktree before the build, one command per line, # comments allowed. The first failure stops it.
project_settings.loeschen_warnung: Delete project {projekt} with all its tickets, agents and settings, for good. Type the project key {key} to confirm.
project_settings.obsidian_notiz_die_agen: Vault note agents read as project context.
project_settings.rechte_vom_uebergeordne: Inherit permissions from the parent project
project_settings.stack_ordner_auf_dem_ho: Stack directory on the host (for deploying).
project_settings.subscription_hinweis: Which subscription or token this project uses when an agent picks none of its own.
project_settings.welche_rolle_plant_bzw_: Which role plans and which executes. Save afterwards.
provider_models_panel.einleitung: Which provider serves which models. Prices are in USD per 1M tokens and drive the cost of each run, 0 means it counts for nothing (local models, for instance). Context is the largest window in tokens, and t/s is the measured output speed, which is exactly the reason to pick a local model, because its price is 0. Models that are switched off disappear from the agent editor but stay available for the accounting of old runs. "Fetch models" asks your endpoints, "Prices" pulls prices and context windows from models.dev, where local models do not appear and stay untouched, so you measure their t/s yourself.
provider_models_panel.katalog_leer: The catalog is empty. "Fetch models" gets them from the endpoints of your provider tokens.
provider_models_panel.preise_aus_dem_off: Take prices from the open catalog models.dev
provider_models_panel.provider_openai: OpenAI compatible (API key or your own endpoint)
resource_grants.einleitung: Fine grained access to a single location or item, without making the user a full project member (a caretaker for one hut and its masts, for instance).
settings.bearbeiten_hinweis: Editing {provider} / {name}. Base URL and default can be changed directly. An empty token field keeps the existing value, enter a new one to replace it.
settings.keys_einleitung: Store your model keys: pick a provider, enter the key, optionally give it a name (to tell several keys of one provider apart). Each agent then picks the key it uses. The one marked as default applies when an agent names none.
settings.name: Name
settings.neuer_wert_leer_behalten: New value (empty keeps the old one)
settings.noch_keine_secrets_im_tresor: No secrets in the vault yet.
settings.secret_loeschen_hinweis: Flows using it will run into nothing afterwards.
settings.secret_name_hinweis: Referenced in flows and destinations as secret:name.
settings.tresor_hinweis: General secret vault: any token or secret (API keys, webhook secrets …). Stored encrypted, the value is never shown again. Referenced as secret:<name>.
settings.wert_ersetzt_hinweis: The stored value never comes back; this replaces it.
skills_panel.version_hinweis: Saving creates version {version}+1; the old one stays.
skills_panel.wiederverwendbare_prompt_ba: Reusable prompt building blocks (versioned). Agents load them through allowed_skills, autostart means permanently active.
slot_list.automatisch_satz_eines_eigentu: Automatic (an owner's set, otherwise the default)
slot_list.eigene_kopie_verwerfen_es_gilt: Drop the copy, the set applies again
slot_list.eigenen_ablauf_dieser_vorgangs: Edit the own flow of this issue type
slot_list.eigenen_ablauf_verwerfen_die_v: Drop the own flow, the issue type follows the set again
slot_list.einleitung: These flows drive the work, from the ticket lifecycle to the review. Without an adaptation the shipped default or the chosen set applies. "Adapt" creates a copy for this project, "reset" throws it away again.
slot_list.herkunft_builtin_hinweis: The shipped flow. Changes to the default take effect here at once.
slot_list.herkunft_project_hinweis: A copy of this project, no longer tied to the set.
slot_list.herkunft_user_hinweis: From the personal set of a project owner.
slot_list.kopie_fuer_dieses_projekt_anle: Create a copy for this project and edit it
stage.beschreibung: Office stage. Alt and the arrow keys pan, plus and minus zoom, Home centers.
stage.kein_lauf: No agent run to see yet.
stage.kiosk_beschreibung: Office stage in wall screen mode. The camera follows on its own.
stage.leer: Empty office, no agent run yet.
stage.mit_agenten: Pixel office with {anzahl} agents in the room.
start_config.artefakt_feld: The artifact sits in this field of the payload
start_config.bedingung_hinweis: Empty means always. The content of the event is checked, available in the flow as {{…}}.
start_config.beispiel_nutzlast_hinweis: Paste once what the other system sends, and its fields are then offered in every decision.
start_config.eigene_namen: Your own names are allowed. A webhook in event mode or POST /api/events reports them.
start_config.nutzlast: The whole payload becomes the context. To map only certain fields, use Settings, Webhooks.
start_config.ohne_angabe: Without it the flow does not start: it belongs to an artifact, and the other system has to say which one.
start_config.projekt_hinweis: If the flow already belongs to a project this applies anyway. It narrows things further, for instance a system wide flow that should run for one project only.
start_config.signatur: Signature: X-Webhook-Signature = HMAC-SHA256 of the body, hex, no prefix. Secret:
status_manager.einleitung: These columns make up the kanban board, from left (open) to right (done).
status_manager.kategorie_hinweis: The category drives the statistics (throughput counts “done”).
status_manager.loeschen_hinweis: A status holding tickets can only be deleted once it is empty.
status_manager.name: Name
subflow_config.hinweis: A named flow resolves to whatever this project uses: its own adaptation, otherwise the set, otherwise the default. A flow of your own is called exactly as it stands and has to be published. Outlets: done and failed.
testenvs.ausgeschaltet: Test environments are switched off for this project (Settings, test environment).
testenvs.baut_branch: Builds the chosen branch in its own throwaway environment, independent of a ticket.
testenvs_panel.kein_container_beim_runne: No container visible on the runner.
ticket_drawer.berechtigung_entscheiden: Decide the permission in the monitor tab or by chat.
ticket_drawer.kein_strukturierter_vorsch: No structured proposal found in the plan.
ticket_drawer.review_befunde_offen_pruef: Review findings are open. Check the diff below, then accept it or comment a correction.
ticket_drawer.startet_die_planung_standa: Starts the planning, the default PM decides staffing and split.
ticket_drawer.testumgebung_startet: starting… (the build takes a few minutes)
ticket_drawer.testumgebung_startet_build: ⏳ Test environment starting… (the build takes a few minutes)
timer.hinweis: Templates are allowed. A time that has passed means now, not never. Nothing waits longer than 90 days.
translations_panel.einleitung: Translations: the keys come from the German catalog shipped with the application. What you enter here applies at once for everyone, and an empty field takes your change back and restores the shipped text.
translations_panel.kein_json: The file is not valid JSON.
translations_panel.loeschen_frage: Delete language {sprache} with all its own texts?
translations_panel.loeschen_titel: Deletes the changes made here. Shipped languages stay available.
update_footer.eingereiht: Update queued, it starts once every agent has finished
update_footer.laeuft: Update running, the stack is being redeployed…
validate.freigabe_abgelehnt: Approval "{knoten}": the rejected outlet is not connected.
validate.freigabe_genehmigt: Approval "{knoten}": the approved outlet is not connected.
validate.genau_ein_start: There has to be exactly one start node (currently {anzahl}).
validate.lose_kante: Edge {kante} points at a node that does not exist.
validate.mindestens_ein_ende: There has to be at least one end node.
wait_event.answer_hinweis: A question answered or a permission decided
wait_event.manual_hinweis: An explicit continue from the interface
wait_event_config.hinweis: While the process waits here, the ticket stays in its current state. This does not skip an approval, that is what the approval node is for.
webhooks_panel.antwort_abwarten: Wait for an answer (seconds, 0 = acknowledge at once)
webhooks_panel.antwort_hinweis: If the call waits, it gets back what the flow itself wrote (action “set answer”). At most 120 seconds.
webhooks_panel.cooldown_erste_zustellung: Cooldown: the first delivery goes through, later events inside the window arrive as one summary.
webhooks_panel.einleitung: Your webhooks. The address carries a GUID (not a user name): POST /api/hooks/<guid>, optionally with HMAC-SHA256 in the header X-Webhook-Signature. A webhook receives and checks — what comes of it stands in the flow: "start a flow" starts one particular flow, "report an event" leaves it to the flows whether they listen.
webhooks_panel.ereignisname_hinweis: Which flows listen is decided by their own trigger. Empty = webhook.<route>.
webhooks_panel.idempotenz_hinweis: A field of the payload (event.id) or composed of several ({account}:{uid}).
webhooks_panel.kontext_fest_hinweis: One assignment per line: target = value. {field} inside the value is filled from the payload; a dot in the target nests it (eingang.agent).
webhooks_panel.kontext_mapping_asset_id_: Context mapping: asset_id: data.id, ort: data.location.name
webhooks_panel.loeschen_hinweis: Calls to this URL will run into nothing afterwards.
webhooks_panel.ohne_mapping: Without a mapping the whole payload becomes the context of the instance.
workflow_editor.dieser_ablauf_gehoert_zu: This flow belongs to a process set. To change it, choose Customize in the project.
workflow_list.einleitung: Extra processes of this project, for webhooks or scheduled jobs. A process is edited as a draft and has to be published before instances can start from it.
workflow_list.name: Name
